correctness.rationale: For every r≥2,t≥3 and a_i≥1, classify t-clique-free faces into K0=join sk_(t−2)Δ_i and a cone over L=join sk_(t−3)Δ_i. If any a_i≤t−2 a private vertex is a cone point. Otherwise direct fixed-vertex acyclic matchings give sphere wedges and the exterior-power augmentation cycle lattices; K0 has connectivity at least dim(L) (strictly larger), so L→K0 is null. Homotopy cofiber yields the asserted two degree formula. The natural relative LES identifies integral Γ modules, with no torsion. The independent literal-clique checker reverified all face predicates, exact F2 Betti vectors in 23 cases (7278 nonempty faces) and 235 signed symmetry Lefschetz traces. Finite cases are only corroboration.

value.rationale: A 2026 theorem gives shellability of clique-free complexes for arbitrary block graphs but no exact invariants. This natural bouquet family has a complete all-arity and all-block-size homotopy classification with two nonconsecutive sphere dimensions for r≥3, sharp contractible/upper-degree thresholds, and full integral within-block group lattices. The group representation is not determined from sphere multiplicities; the formula is a motivated precise classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a renaming of the earlier qualitative theorem.
